title: Board Handle Link Drag Snap And Preview
description: Implement handle-to-handle linking on the elements board: drag from a handle with movement threshold shows an open polyline preview (screen space), snap cursor to nearest compatible handle within tolerance (world/screen derived), commit new edge on pointer-up with edgeCreate event; extend BoardRenderer applyWasmDrainToScene for edgeCreate; add Rust host tests and extend existing TS tests.
